name: Ironcap Swordsmen
headerMeta: Chivalric era · Melee Infantry (Sword & Shield) · charge-focused · 100 leadership · T2 Mastery
pitch: A cheap charge-cycling unit that trades sustained melee for devastating charge damage and burst CC potential. Best used hit-and-run against fragile targets; once engaged in open melee against quality units, it gets overwhelmed quickly.

doctrines.name: Charge Defence Doctrine
doctrines.effect: -40% DMG taken while charging. Mandatory per Amya.

doctrines.name: Stamina Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: -24% charge CD, +1 charge target. Mandatory per Amya.

doctrines.name: Piercing-Defense Doctrine
doctrines.note: pushes ranged defence toward 300s — critical given ~7,600 HP and ~30s base defence {2}

doctrines.name: Blunt-Damage Doctrines
doctrines.note: boost charge damage (unit's charge is blunt-type) {2}

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Charge-focused build — increased charge damage and decreased charge cooldown, trading away defense for higher burst; two sources align on this path {1,2}

battleRole.positioning: Bait or position enemies into a charge vector; charge into the back of a unit or into heroes for burst kills {2}. Unit's low base defence (~30s) means archers can tear it apart out-of-position {2}.
battleRole.tips: Charge-cycle playstyle: charge, disengage, reset (~12-second cooldown), charge again {2}. Never stay in prolonged open melee against stronger units — this unit's value is almost entirely in the charge itself {2}. Charging down siege-tower chokepoints (funneled single-file) works well; fragile once committed to open combat, especially against Condottieri, Falconet/Gunner fire, or coordinated pushes {2}. Vulnerable to CC after a charge {2}.

cards.name: Iron Reapers
cards.why: shield-break mechanic catches up; initial charge can score kills but reapers recover {2}

cards.name: Heroes (backline/isolated)
cards.why: high blunt charge damage scores fast kills on contact {2}

matchups.siblings: Rattan Roundshields play as the weaker sibling - similar HP and base attack, but noticeably less charge damage and not enough slashing pen to threaten anything above low/mid tier. Ironcaps land 1,000+ per hit against Condottieri where Rattans need 15-20 hits, and cut through Halberdiers far more cleanly. {3}

controls.notes: Charge → backline hero or unit flank → disengage and pull back → ~12-second cooldown → charge again {2}.
